thought.text: The form uses `BackendLoginForm` fields and CSRF is disabled. Let me log in properly.

reasoning_content: The form uses `BackendLoginForm[username]` and `BackendLoginForm[password]`. There's no CSRF token in the form (it's probably disabled — `ENABLE_CSRF_VALIDATION_BACKEND=false` in .env). Let me try submitting the login with the correct field names.

action.command:
cd /workspace && docker exec yii2_vue_dash_container bash -c '
curl -s -c /tmp/cj4.txt -o /dev/null -w "login_page code=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/administration/site/login
curl -s -b /tmp/cj4.txt -c /tmp/cj4.txt -o /tmp/login_resp2.html -w "login_post code=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1/administration/site/login --data-urlencode "BackendLoginForm[username]=admin" --data-urlencode "BackendLoginForm[password]=QUJhwuG8KQtCPFyv"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj4.txt -o /tmp/dashboard.html -w "dashboard code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n" http://127.0.0.1/administration/site/index
grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/dashboard.html | head -2'
